### Visual plan

The strongest picture for every line, picked from three (hooks from five). Scores out of 12: stop · line · feel · specific · fresh · makeable.

### Hook 1 — At sixty three, I ran into my ex-husband in Walmart.

| | First frame | Stakes | Where | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **▶ picked** | her cart rolling fast up a bright aisle as his swings round the end-cap — the two carts slam nose to nose | who is the man, and why does she look so calm after the crash? | a huge bright big-box store aisle at midday | 11/12 |
| B | Peter's face mid-double-take, mouth open, eyes travelling head to toe | what is he seeing? | the end of the same aisle | 10/12 |
| C | Michelle gliding away down the walkway, unbothered, two people frozen behind her | what just happened back there? | the store's main walkway | 10/12 |
| D | the younger woman's hand tightening on Peter's arm as she stiffens | a rival sizing someone up | beside the end-cap | 9/12 |
